lines.text: The Early Childhood option provides opportunities for
students to bring together subject matter knowledge,
appropriate strategies, and interpersonal skills essential
to provide successful learning experiences for children.
Students will be versed in individualized instruction
and sensitive to developmental and sociocultural issues
***FYEX 1110 First-Year Seminar is required for all
degree-seeking students with fewer than 30 credit
hours successfully completed including transfer credits.
